specs.procedure: Use calibrated digital torque wrench per TEM 05-00-00. Check bolt head for marking. Tighten in criss-cross pattern.
specs.safety: Do not exceed specification. Risk of structural failure. Re-check after first 10 flight hours.

specs.procedure: Engine must be cold. Torque in ascending sequence per TEM.
specs.safety: Inadequate torque can cause engine shift during flight. Safety critical.

specs.procedure: Use flush socket per TEM. Ensure washer is seated properly.
specs.safety: Over-tightening strips threads. Environmental sealing critical.

specs.procedure: Gear must be fully extended. Use locking compound on all connections per SRM.
specs.safety: Under-torquing causes gear collapse. CRITICAL - re-check monthly.

specs.procedure: Torque in star pattern. Verify after tightening per TSM.
specs.safety: Improper torque causes brake failure. CRITICAL - perform brake test after service.

specs.procedure: Support door during tightening. Check alignment after per TEM.
specs.safety: Ensure door operates freely without binding. Verify latch engagement.

specs.procedure: Use backup wrench per TEM. System must be depressurized before work.
specs.safety: Hydraulic pressure testing required after connection. Check for leaks.

specs.procedure: Gentle tightening. Do not over-torque aluminum per TEM 05-00-00.
specs.safety: Over-tightening damages aircraft systems. Use soft washers.

specs.procedure: Ensure PTFE tape on threads per SRM. Pressurization test required.
specs.safety: Improper sealing causes oxygen leakage - CRITICAL. Perform leak test.

specs.procedure: Control surfaces must be neutral. Verify movement after per TSM.
specs.safety: Loose linkage affects aircraft handling - CRITICAL. Perform control check.

materials.name: Titanium
materials.notes: Lightweight, high strength. Use lower torque values.

materials.name: Steel
materials.notes: Standard. Use base torque values from tables.

materials.name: Stainless Steel
materials.notes: High corrosion resistance. Slightly higher torque.
